text:
incbot: PAGER: high-severity alert for nexusbank VPC gateway — elevated websocket disconnects and stream timeouts, paging #oncall-sre

Maya (oncall-sre): noticed surge of 499s and 504s coming from nexusbank app cluster. dashboards show connection churn ~7.8k conn attempts/min. looks tenant-isolated so paging infra/runtime with customer tag.

Ben (infra): grep logs: repeated TLS handshake aborts followed by reconnect flurry. top culprit: client-app-id=app-nexus-frontend-02 from a small CIDR block.

Charlie (runtime): traffic is landing on nexusbank-dedicated-pool-3. KV cache eviction rate spiked, lots of partial streams held in memory. might be upgrade-induced retry loop.

Maya (oncall-sre): @ops-manager please escalate to NexusBank SE and ask customer to check latest deploy. Meanwhile Ben, can we apply protective limits to the pool to keep control-plane healthy?

Ben (infra): applying conservative token-bucket: 
`rctl apply --pool nexusbank-dedicated-pool-3 --rate 2500/s --burst 400`
I'll also lower accept window for new ws connections to limit storm.

incbot: Action logged — rate limit applied by Ben at 2543220065

Charlie (runtime): pushing pool config tweak to avoid half-open stream buildup:
```
pool: nexusbank-dedicated-pool-3
ws_keepalive: 75s
max_streams_per_conn: 1100
stream_eviction_policy: aggressive
```
Deployed at 2543220090. note: KV GC cycles increased during deploy.

Maya (oncall-sre): reaching out to NexusBank (nexusbank-sre) now. can you confirm any client-side retry/backoff changes?

NexusBank SRE (nexusbank-sre): yep — we rolled a frontend change ~4m ago that tweaks proxy error handling. seeing immediate reconnects from the app. rolling back the change and disabling aggressive retry logic (we'll add jitter/backoff). ETA ~3m.

Ben (infra): after rollback start, inbound connect rate fell ~60%. error counts declining but p50 ws latency still high for some sessions (residual churn).

Charlie (runtime): toggled runtime partial-stream flush feature for this pool to avoid sticky KV entries: `runtime.flag.flush_partial_streams=true --target nexusbank-dedicated-pool-3` — toggled at 2543220180. enabling short dedupe at ingress for identical connection tokens (60s window).

Maya (oncall-sre): great. ops-manager, draft customer-facing incident note: summarize impact window, mitigations we executed, and suggested SDK/backoff guidance. also request packet captures or traces for top offending client IPs.

ops-manager: drafting now. current impact note: "Streaming degraded for NexusBank during client rollback window (approx 08:12-08:22 UTC). Symptoms: increased disconnects, some aborted long-lived sessions. Mitigations: customer rollback, pool rate-limiting, ws keepalive increase, partial-stream flush, ingress dedupe. No cross-tenant impact detected."

Sol (solutions): I'll work with NexusBank on an SDK defensive pattern guide — recommend exponential backoff with jitter, circuit-breaker at SDK level, and connection pool sizing. will create a follow-up ticket.

Maya (oncall-sre): handing off active monitoring to day oncall @Alice. My shift ends in 12m. Alice, summary to include:
- probable root cause: frontend proxy change causing tight reconnect loops
- scope: tenant-isolated, nexusbank-dedicated-pool-3 only
- mitigations applied: rate-limiting, pool ws keepalive bump, partial stream eviction, ingress dedupe, customer rollback
- actions for postmortem: collect traces/pcap for top 5 client IPs, export KV eviction logs, share config diffs and timestamps, recommend SDK/backoff changes to customer

Alice (oncall-day): ack — taking over. creating incident record and scheduling postmortem sync with NexusBank SRE. will keep thread open and monitor for 30m.

Maya (oncall-sre): thanks all :thumbsup: I'll mark paging resolved but leave thread active for any late regressions.

incbot: Incident state transitioned to MONITORING at 2543221350
